About Our Team :

We are a team of three developers participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. We are passionate about technology, problem-solving, innovation, and exploring how software can help us better understand the universe.

For the Planet X and SPHEREx challenge, we aim to build an interactive web application that makes astronomical data easier to explore and helps users visualize changes in the sky over time.

Let's explore the universe together and turn data into discovery!
